definitions.explanation: a type of iron alloy with a high carbon content that is poured into molds and allowed to solidify; valued for its durability and heat retention

examples.japanese: {鋳鉄|ちゅうてつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦フライパン→フライパン：01025_furaipan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{熱|ねつ}→熱：01690_netsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{伝|つた}える→伝える：01220_tsutaeru⟧。
examples.english: A cast iron frying pan conducts heat well.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{鋳鉄|ちゅうてつ}⟦{製|せい}→〜製：02001_sei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{鍋|なべ}→鍋：01038_nabe⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{重|おも}い→重い：00804_omoi⟧⟦けれど→けれど：01990_keredo⟧⟦{長持|ながも}ち→長持ち：14474_nagamochi⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: This cast iron pot is heavy, but it lasts a long time.

examples.japanese: {南部鉄器|なんぶてっき}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{岩手県|いわてけん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{作|つく}られる→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧⟦{伝統的|でんとうてき}→伝統的：04802_dentouteki⟧な{鋳鉄|ちゅうてつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{工芸品|こうげいひん}→工芸品：15367_kougeihin⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{急須|きゅうす}→急須：04980_kyuusu⟧や{鉄瓶|てつびん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧だ。
examples.english: Nanbu ironware is a traditional cast iron craft made in Iwate Prefecture, famous for its teapots and iron kettles.

notes:
Composed of {鋳|ちゅう} (casting; molding metal) + ⟦{鉄|てつ}→鉄：02225_tetsu⟧ (iron). Cast iron is produced by melting iron and pouring it into molds, as opposed to {鍛鉄|たんてつ} (wrought iron), which is hammered into shape. Cast iron is brittle but excels at heat retention, making it ideal for cookware.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {鋳鉄|ちゅうてつ}⟦{製|せい}→〜製：02001_sei⟧: made of cast iron
- {鋳鉄|ちゅうてつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{鍋|なべ}→鍋：01038_nabe⟧: cast iron pot
- {鋳鉄|ちゅうてつ}{管|かん}: cast iron pipe
- {鋳鉄|ちゅうてつ}⟦{製|せい}→〜製：02001_sei⟧⟦フライパン→フライパン：01025_furaipan⟧: cast iron frying pan

CULTURAL NOTE:
Japan has a rich tradition of cast iron craftsmanship. {南部鉄器|なんぶてっき} (Nanbu ironware) from Iwate Prefecture is internationally recognized, particularly the {鉄瓶|てつびん} (iron kettle) used for boiling water, which is said to improve the taste of tea by adding trace iron.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {鍛鉄|たんてつ}: wrought iron — iron that is hammered rather than cast
- ⟦{鋼|はがね}→鋼：14739_hagane⟧: steel — an iron alloy with lower carbon content, stronger and more flexible than cast iron
- {鉄器|てっき}: ironware — a general term for tools and utensils made of iron
